shadows.name: window-ambient
shadows.purpose: Ambient separation for the floating palette window, paired with a faint inner top highlight.

shadows.purpose: Four-sided inner highlight plus a compact external shadow confined to the header's lower edge.

shadows.purpose: Inner white edge, black physical border, gray outer outline, and soft separation for launcher tiles.

shadows.name: selection-signal
shadows.value: 1px #F36A2D middle edge with neutral inner and outer layers

components.name: Command Tile
components.description: Square launcher action with a precise selected signal.
components.css: .ds-command-tile{display:grid;grid-template-rows:18px 1fr 34px;width:113px;aspect-ratio:1;padding:8px 10px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.88);border-radius:2px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#24262c,#21242a);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.055),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12),0 7px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.26);font:450 13px/1.22 'HarmonyOS Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;transition:transform 100ms,border-color 100ms,background 100ms,box-shadow 100ms}.ds-tile-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.ds-tile-top kbd{min-width:20px;height:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:4px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);background:#15181e;font:600 10px/1 'HarmonyOS Sans',sans-serif}.ds-tile-top i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#f36a2d}.ds-command-tile>svg{align-self:end;justify-self:center;width:32px;height:32px;margin-bottom:10px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-command-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#292d34;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.07),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16),0 9px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}.ds-command-tile:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.52);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-command-tile[aria-selected=true]{border-color:#f36a2d;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.055),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12),0 7px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 0 10px rgba(243,106,45,.08)}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact active search field with one orange focus signal.

components.name: Command Row
components.description: Dense search and catalog row with metadata kept subordinate.
components.css: .ds-command-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:8px;width:360px;min-height:58px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.88);border-radius:2px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#24262c,#21242a);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.055),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12),0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.22);font-family:'HarmonyOS Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left}.ds-command-row:hover{background:#292d34;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.07),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16),0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.26)}.ds-command-row:focus-visible{border-color:#f36a2d;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);background:#292d34;outline:none}.ds-command-icon{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:6px;background:#191d24}.ds-command-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-command-icon i{position:absolute;top:-3px;right:-3px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#f36a2d}.ds-command-copy{display:grid;min-width:0;gap:3px}.ds-command-copy strong{overflow:hidden;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);font-size:14px;line-height:1.2;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-command-copy small{display:flex;gap:7px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-size:11px}.ds-command-copy em{color:#f36a2d;font-style:normal}

components.name: Icon Control
components.description: Forty-pixel control zone inside the continuous header surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-control" aria-label="Pin command"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 17v5M5 17h14M6 3h12l-1 7 3 3H4l3-3z"/></svg></button>

components.name: Alphabet Control
components.description: Persistent right-edge catalog index sharing the Launcher and Header field background, paired with a hidden-scrollbar list.
components.css: .ds-alpha{display:grid;width:32px;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:3px;background:#202327;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.42);font-family:'HarmonyOS Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-alpha button{position:relative;min-height:18px;border:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);background:transparent;font-size:10px;font-weight:650}.ds-alpha button.active{color:#f36a2d}.ds-alpha button.active:before{position:absolute;inset:25% auto 25% 0;width:1px;background:#f36a2d;content:''}.ds-alpha button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #f36a2d;outline-offset:-1px}.ds-alpha button:disabled{opacity:.25}

components.name: Header Surface
components.description: One continuous inset header body divided into brand, Pin, and Settings zones.
components.css: .ds-header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 40px 40px;width:360px;height:40px;overflow:hidden;border:0;border-radius:4px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#202327,#1c1f23);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 2px 2px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.8);font-family:'HarmonyOS Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:0 12px}.ds-brand i{width:2px;height:24px;border-radius:2px;background:#f36a2d}.ds-brand strong{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.16em}.ds-header button{position:relative;border:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);background:transparent}.ds-header button:hover,.ds-header button:focus-visible{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);background:#292d34;outline:1px solid #f36a2d;outline-offset:-1px}

components.name: Launcher Toolbar
components.description: Grid-aligned launcher strip with the All Actions grip and centered search prompt.
components.css: .ds-toolbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr;width:357px;height:38px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(24,26,30,.72);box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04),0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.22);font-family:'HarmonyOS Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-toolbar button{border:0;background:transparent}.ds-grip{display:grid;place-items:center;color:#f36a2d}.ds-grip svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor}.ds-prompt{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 9px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);font-size:12px}.ds-prompt:before{position:absolute;inset:7px auto 7px 0;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);content:''}.ds-toolbar button:hover,.ds-toolbar button:focus-visible{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);outline:1px solid #f36a2d;outline-offset:-1px}

narrative.overview: Clackly is a compact professional control surface that appears inside the editor's existing Resolve workflow, performs one focused job, and gets out of the way. Its visual language combines Resolve-grade dark tonal layering with the immediacy of Spotlight and FX Console, while rejecting the oversized cards, generous empty space and playful softness of consumer launchers.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral layers separated by tone and hairline borders.
Orange used sparingly for active state, focus and identity.
Small controlled radii and a consistent lucide-react line-icon vocabulary.
Fast motion that confirms state without becoming decoration.

rules.name: The Orange Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the accent only for the logo mark, focus, active selection, pinned indicators and essential state. Never fill a full tile with orange.

rules.name: The Two-Line Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Command labels may use at most two lines; supporting metadata must truncate before the interface loses density.

rules.name: The Workspace Preservation Rule
rules.body: Every layout must occupy only the space required for the current task and must not turn into a full application window.

dos: Do preserve complete keyboard operation and visible focus/selection.
Do use CSS variables for every confirmed color and reusable measurement.
Do preserve the path-only custom SVG wordmark and mark, and use lucide-react SVG components for interface icons.
Do keep launcher icons and one/two-line command labels optically centered as one command unit.
Do render only registered Command metadata and use the truthful empty state when none is available.
donts: Don't use large glow, full-orange tiles, gradient text or decorative glass effects.
Don't use SVG <text> or font-dependent rendering for the CLACKLY wordmark.
Don't use radii above 16px, oversized whitespace or card-heavy consumer layouts.
Don't let UI code know how Resolve actions are implemented.
Don't add a dedicated History control; history influences ranking instead.
